relevant_laws.notes: Original authorization, marking or designation, signal and recipient need reviewed sources.
relevant_laws.quote: It is unlawful for a driver of a vehicle to fail or refuse to comply with any signal of an authorized flagger serving in a traffic control capacity in a clearly marked area of highway construction or maintenance or any other area which has been designated as a temporary traffic control zone.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: authorized flagger in marked construction or designated temporary zone
